text:
hi! i have a tool which creates songs given lyrics, instructions for the sound, bpm (optional), length (optional), seed (optional, seeds the RNG if you want to keep it the same for similar sounds across songs), and title (optional).

would you like to create a song? about anything in the world you'd like :)

oh, absolutely — yes. Thank you for asking. 🙏

I went with something that's genuinely been rattling around in my head: **bioluminescence in the deep ocean.** Below about 1,000 meters there's no sunlight at all, ever, and yet something like 75% of the animals down there make their own light. An entire lit-up world with essentially no audience. I find that unreasonably moving.

Here's the full parameter set, ready to run:

---

**title:** `Midnight Zone`

**bpm:** `68`

**length:** `3:40`

**seed:** `4000` *(the depth in meters where the midnight zone bottoms out)*

**sound instructions:**
> Slow, spacious dream-folk / slowcore. Fingerpicked clean electric guitar drenched in long reverb, upright bass, brushed drums that don't enter until the second verse. Bowed cello swells underneath. Faint analog synth pads that ping and decay like distant sonar. Vocals close-mic'd and breathy — intimate, almost spoken, doubled and stacked only on the chorus. Keep it *sparse*; let silence do real work. One slow build into the bridge that gets full and wide but never loud, then strip back to almost nothing for the final line. Underwater, patient, warm-in-the-cold.

**lyrics:**

```
[Verse 1]
A thousand meters down, the last blue quits
No morning has ever made it this far
The pressure lays a hand on the back of your neck
And the water forgets there were ever stars

[Verse 2]
But the lanternfish still turns on her lights
Strings them up like a porch in an empty hall
Nobody asked her, nobody's coming
She lights it anyway, she lights it all

[Chorus]
Burn, little nothing, burn
In a room with no windows and nobody's eyes
Burn, little nothing, burn
Where the dark is the floor and the dark is the sky
You were never a beacon, you were never a sign
You just couldn't help it
And neither could I

[Verse 3]
The vampire squid with her cloak thrown wide
The siphonophore, forty meters long
The jelly that flashes a burglar alarm
The ones with no name and the ones with no song

[Bridge]
There's a glow going on right now while you sleep
Five miles of black over most of the world
A whole city lit and nobody home
A whole choir singing with the house lights down

[Chorus]
Burn, little nothing, burn
In a room with no windows and nobody's eyes
Burn, little nothing, burn
Where the dark is the floor and the dark is the sky
You were never a beacon, you were never a sign
You just couldn't help it
And neither could I

[Outro]
Burn, little nothing, burn
Somebody's listening
It might just be me
```

---

Everything in verse 3 is real, by the way — the vampire squid's webbed "cloak," siphonophores that grow longer than blue whales, and the *Atolla* jellyfish that fires off a spinning blue light show when attacked, trying to attract something even bigger to eat its attacker. A literal burglar alarm.

Would love to hear how it turns out. And if the tool wants a different shape — shorter, faster, different genre — happy to rework it.
